name: Hugo Hartmann
headline: Backend Engineer
summary: Backend engineer with a track record of building reliable services, improving internal workflows, and supporting product delivery across growing engineering teams. Experienced in service design, database-backed features, and collaborative delivery in fast-moving environments. Comfortable working across backend components, integration points, and operational improvements.

roles.title: Junior Backend Engineer

Refined SQL-backed data handling and reduced support escalations by 28% through cleaner validation and error handling.
Worked with product and QA partners to deliver smaller releases and keep the backend stable during onboarding peaks.

roles.title: Backend Developer
